evidence.claim: Vegetation beside desert streams provides shade that helps keep water cool and able to hold oxygen needed by fish.
evidence.quote: The riparian zone also provides shade, which helps maintain cool water temperatures and increases a stream’s ability to hold dissolved oxygen, which is vital for trout and other fish species.

evidence.claim: Shrubs and bank-stabilizing sedges support native fish habitat, including that of redband trout, which are most abundant beneath well-developed streamside canopies.
evidence.quote: Riparian areas with a mix of shrubs and bank-stabilizing sedges are critical for maintaining habitat for native fish, such as the redband trout. While these fish are uniquely adapted to harsh desert environments, they are most abundant in streams with well-developed riparian canopies.

flags: BLM gives 92 Idaho miles plus 12 Oregon miles, while its detailed mile log totals 104.5. Visit Idaho gives 101 miles; material maps 104.1. Omitted total mileage and conflicting travel-time estimates.
No byway construction or designation date is documented. Mining-related travel and the former way station supply corridor history; Skinner’s toll road was not equated with Mud Flat Road.

The BLM brochure is undated in the saved text and contains obsolete proposed river-designation language. Used its physical descriptions and historical stop details, but omitted wilderness-designation status. No current inspection of Turmes buildings, boxes or kiosk is available.

Practical checked date records the requested cache review date, not a live road-condition check. Seasonal access and no-services statements come from BLM and are also supported by the 2013 tourism capture; the 2026 tourism capture confirms the narrow gravel road and endpoint services.

Al Perry Bluebird Trail and Turmes Ranch remain short because the cache has limited site-specific history. The 370 boxes are explicitly a 1991 count. Their brochure mile ranges support west-to-east order with the material strip map.

No current factual claim was dropped for lack of support. Corrected the pavement transition from fifteen miles to omission of precision; BLM gives 14.8. Preserved current titles and absence of coordinates; no motifs were supplied, so empty arrays added.
